name: 2004 Real Soccer
summary:
How would you like to relive the excitement of the greatest ever soccer matches? Well, now you can enjoy all the thrills of the best console games on your mobile phone, with 2004 Real Soccer!
Prepare yourself for hours and hours of play, if you’re set on winning the most prestigious tournament. And don’t overlook the friendly matches, if you want to sharpen your skills for the biggest game of them all – the European Cup!
When the referee blows that whistle, the action starts – long and short passes, tackles, penalty kicks – whatever it takes to win that match!
